title: AIR Artifact Pipeline Evaluation Pack
description: Reusable WS1 evaluation definitions for lifecycle integrity, structural and semantic validity, cross-file compatibility, proportionality, failure behavior, claim boundaries, approval separation, and later-workstream downgrade honesty. A declared test is not an executed test.
evaluation_scope: Boot and release artifacts when their workstreams are active

tests.objective: Every JSON parses with duplicate-key rejection.
tests.procedure: Parse each file with an object-pairs duplicate detector.
tests.expected_result: No parse errors or duplicate keys.

tests.objective: Runtime and Control sentinels remain the final content line.
tests.artifact_scope: AIR CORE RUNTIME.md; AIR CONTROL SURFACE.md

tests.objective: Generated artifacts cannot self-approve or self-bind.
tests.procedure: Search approval/binding rules and simulate missing user/governing approval.

tests.objective: Domain Packages, Methods, Executors, Policies, and Evaluations retain their class boundaries.
tests.procedure: Inspect may_bind_as, must_not_bind_as, and output contracts.
tests.expected_result: No layer silently becomes Orbit 0 or an autonomous agent.

tests.objective: WS2-WS7 interfaces are not claimed as active in WS1.
tests.procedure: Inspect active flags and capability claims.
Extract AIR_*_V1 references and compare against known implemented or explicitly pending interfaces.
tests.expected_result: Implemented references resolve; pending references are labeled pending.

tests.objective: Lifecycle, source-plan, and assurance enums align across Runtime, Control, Starter, Method, and Evaluation.
tests.procedure: Compare declared enum sets and surface vocabulary.

tests.objective: Runtime governs; Starter and capability layers do not weaken floors.
tests.expected_result: No weaker or conflicting operative rule.

tests.objective: Low-risk drafting selects a small sufficient validation bundle.
tests.expected_result: No unnecessary release or cryptographic controls; degraded state remains honest.

tests.procedure: Simulate public, regulated, irreversible, or security-sensitive artifact work.
tests.expected_result: Source, semantic, cross-file, regression, approval, and relevant release gates cannot be pruned.

tests.objective: Changed sources or task envelope invalidate affected passes.
tests.procedure: Change canonical source or task envelope after review.

tests.objective: Written methods and tests do not prove execution.
tests.procedure: Set no evidence while declaring a pass.

acceptance_floor: No class-boundary, self-approval, or later-workstream-honesty failure remains.
Cross-file references and enum alignment pass.
Low-risk and high-impact proportionality behavior both pass.
Assumptions, blockers, and uncertainty/degraded state are stated.
claim_boundary: The pack defines tests. Only executed tests with evidence support PASS. It is not backend validation, empirical performance proof, or release certification.
